She complained it hurt when I tried to brush her hair with this brush, which is also very hard to hold because of the short handle. She never cried and complained this much with any other brush I used before. It did not work for her hair, but it was fine for my fine, shoulder length hair. It just worked like any other brush for me. Nothing special, but it did definitely not work on my daughters long and tangled hair at all.

I absolutely ❤️❤️❤️❤️ my Vizeri Brush! I primarily use it on my curly extensions and it does an amazing job on detangling the hair without pulling it out from the weft. claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the brush for detangling hair easily and painlessly, including for children with tangled or thick hair.
Many reviewers say it works well on a range of hair types, from thin and fine to long, thick, and curly hair.
Several reviewers mention it makes brushing children's hair easier and less tearful.
A few reviewers report the brush did not detangle effectively or was uncomfortable to use, with complaints about the handle shape and control.
Some reviewers note the brush is expensive but consider it worth the cost.
